verdict.rationale: Vanta's questionnaire automation product says it combs through your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses. It also positions the workflow as review, approve, and submit, with the AI Agent completing questionnaires and API endpoints for managing questionnaire responses. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers draw on live controls (not just documents and past questionnaires), detail on the draft-review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill

citations.quote: Vanta combs through your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires.
Vanta takes care of the heavy lifting—so all you need to do is review, approve, and submit.
working tirelessly across the Vanta platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues before they escalate.
Four new endpoints manage the responses on a Customer Trust questionnaire.
